newPatientVisit.covers: Exam, a full set of X-rays and a cleaning
newPatientVisit.regularCleaning: A regular cleaning. If the hygienist finds gum disease, the dentist talks through a deeper cleaning first.

special.offer: Join the savings plan this month: the first visit is included instead of $129, plus free take-home whitening once the dentist gives the okay.
special.whitening: Free take-home whitening trays once the dentist gives the okay; members keep their cleanings to keep it.

plan.name: Aspen Grove Savings Plan
plan.term: A 12-month plan, paid monthly, or once a year for less.
covers: Two cleanings and exams a year
15% off fillings, crowns and other treatment
plan.simple: No deductible, no waiting period, no yearly maximum.
plan.notInsurance: It's the practice's own plan, not insurance.
plan.signUp: The sign-up link goes by text with the new-patient forms. Enrollment is confirmed at check-in.
plan.household: Anyone else at home can join too (kids are $25 a month): their sign-up and forms come with the caller's intake forms, and they can call back with any questions or to book.
